Welch Allyn’s **ophthalmology tools** are mainly their **ophthalmoscopes**, **ophthalmic exam sets**, **power handles**, and **digital image-capture accessories** for eye exams.[2][3][5]

The most prominent current products in the results are:
- **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope** — a wide-view ophthalmoscope designed to give a larger viewing area and include **Quick Eye alignment** to help with optic disc alignment.[1][2][4]
- **MacroView Plus Otoscope** — while primarily an ear exam tool, it is part of Welch Allyn’s newer physical exam line and can be paired with the **iExaminer SmartBracket** for digital capture.[1]
- **iExaminer SmartBracket / iExaminer Pro** — accessories used to attach a smart device and capture digital images during the eye exam.[1][4][6]
- **Ophthalmic Sets** — portable 3.5 V diagnostic sets that include the **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope**, LED illumination, and **rechargeable power handles**.[2]
- **Traditional ophthalmoscopes and retinoscopes** — available through Welch Allyn ophthalmic equipment sellers and product listings.[3][5]

If you want, I can also list the **specific Welch Allyn ophthalmology product names by category** or help you compare **PanOptic Plus vs standard ophthalmoscope**.
